name: In Demand - Titan Relics
summary: Pix Xizzix in Booty Bay seeks three relics tied to the Titans, their followers, and the Burning Legion. Dalaran researchers want the artifacts recovered from dangerous places.

sections.title: Relics Wanted
sections.body: Pix Xizzix in Booty Bay asks you to recover three artifacts for researchers from Dalaran. Ysera’s Tear lies with the Shade of Eranikus in the Sunken Temple, while Varrox Bleakhoof holds a Mark of Xavius in Blackmaw Hold. Nanaya has Freya’s Sigil at the Shaper’s Terrace. Bring all three to Pix.

faq.answer: Pix Xizzix in Booty Bay is collecting the relics for researchers from Dalaran.

faq.q: Which relics am I looking for?
faq.answer: You are asked to recover Ysera’s Tear, a Mark of Xavius, and Freya’s Sigil.
The Shade of Eranikus in the Sunken Temple has Ysera’s Tear.

faq.q: Who has the Mark of Xavius?
faq.answer: Varrox Bleakhoof in Blackmaw Hold has a Mark of Xavius.
Nanaya in the Shaper’s Terrace has Freya’s Sigil.

faq.q: Who should I bring the relics to?
faq.answer: Bring all three relics to Pix Xizzix in Booty Bay.
